sources.entry: imagor - Fast, secure image processing server and Go library built on libvips, with on-demand resizing, cropping, filtering, format conversion and image composition, signed URLs and streaming pipelines for high-concurrency throughput. Apache-2.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: imagor is a fast, secure image processing server and Go library built on libvips, offering thumbor-style URL-based image transformations over HTTP.
summary.what_it_does: imagor is an HTTP image processing server and Go library that uses libvips (via the vipsgen Go binding). It adopts the thumbor URL syntax for on-demand image operations. The README names resizing, cropping, filtering, format conversion and image composition as supported use cases, and the awesome-selfhosted listing adds signed URLs and streaming pipelines. It implements libvips streaming to run parallel processing pipelines for high network throughput. Documentation covers the image endpoint, filters, storage, security and configuration. A companion project, imagorvideo, adds video thumbnails via ffmpeg C bindings, and Imagor MCP adds template composition for agents.
use_cases: on-demand image resizing and cropping over HTTP
image format conversion such as serving WebP
generating social cards or composed images from templates
notable: Built on libvips streaming for parallel pipelines and high throughput
Thumbor URL syntax, usable as a drop-in replacement
Available both as a standalone HTTP server and as a Go library
First-class Docker support with a one-line quick start
Companion imagorvideo and Imagor MCP projects
caveats: The quick start uses -imagor-unsafe, which disables URL signing; production use should configure security
Commercial support and consulting are offered separately from the open-source project
Video capability depends on the separate imagorvideo project
